connector.name: MCP Grantiq
connector.registryDescription: Search US grants + federal contracts (Grants.gov + SAM.gov) from any LLM.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.grantiq.us over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package grantiq-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bch1212 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
